interface.reset: synchronous active-low resetn; coordinated system reset clears pipeline valid and sums
interface.input: step_valid/step_ready; A[16] signed8, B[16 output channels][16 K] signed8; row_index7, first_k, last_k, n_valid5, output tag and cached FP32 combined scale
interface.layout: byte lane0 is bits7:0; B byte index=n*16+k; n_valid1..16; row_index0..95
interface.output: result_valid/result_ready; sixteen signed INT32 sums, same tag, scale and valid-channel count; stable while stalled
interface.stall: elastic pipeline; never overwrite unretired results; stall propagates to step_ready; no accepted step dropped or duplicated

architecture.dataflow: For each N16 panel, stream ascending K32 panels; for each K16 half issue all logical rows. Accumulate each row/N lane across the complete K; reuse B panel across rows and three GQA query heads.
architecture.dsp_packing: disabled baseline; 256 independent registered signed 8x8 product paths; no assumption of packing correction
architecture.pipeline: nominal multiply1 + balanced reduction4 + accumulation1 cycles; elastic stalls affect latency, not association or arithmetic
architecture.psum_storage: 16 channel partitions, each96 signed32 entries, asynchronous local read and registered sum update; bypass if selected memory primitive adds a read latency. Consecutive K steps for row0 must sustain acceptance each cycle.
architecture.row_initialization: first_k replaces prior sum; intermediate steps add; last_k emits completed vector. Command/next N panel cannot reuse a context before old tagged steps drain.
architecture.masking: zero invalid K products and N channels before reduction; no -128 and no negative probability accepted as legal operands

numeric.reassociation: legal exact integer additions may be tree-reassociated; no narrowing or per-K rescaling

verification.comparison: bitwise INT32 equality to independent Python integer dot products
cases: reset with valid work; no stale completion
verification.performance: 256 products accepted per unstalled cycle once operands are staged; demonstrate row0 feedback at II1 and all256 live product paths in synthesis
